audit_scope: AAR (aarauctions.com) + NYSAuctions (nysauctions.com, 301 -> aarauctions.com) historical/current Greene County NY tax-foreclosure auctions. Read-only. stdlib HTTP, no Playwright.

method.pagination: page=N&perPage=20&orderBy=  (20 lots per page; 3 pages => 41-60 lots)
index_pages_pulled: https://aarauctions.com/sitemap_index.xml -> post + page sitemap (0 Greene tax-foreclosure entries)
notes: AAR's WP marketing pages (upcoming, tax-foreclosures, results, calendar) only show CURRENTLY ACTIVE auctions; once an auction closes it disappears from those indexes.
Closed auctions are still served by the catalog servlet indefinitely (3+ years confirmed - 3738 from Oct 2022 is fully accessible).
There is no machine listing endpoint that enumerates Greene auctions. ID-sweep is the only enumeration method.
The catalog HTML is gzipped on the wire with --compressed transparently decoded; raw bytes contain CRLF + embedded NULs in JS strings, so use python (not grep) to parse.

missing_years_finding.interpretation: Across the full ID range 2300-8500 (covering AAR auctions from ~2018 through May 2026), only TWO Greene County tax-foreclosure auctions exist on AAR: auctionId=3738 (Oct 2022) and auctionId=6892 (Oct 2025). No Greene tax sale appears for 2021, 2023, or 2024 under any title. Either Greene County did not run a tax-foreclosure sale those years, used a different vendor, or conducted it in-house. There is also no Greene auction yet scheduled for fall 2026 (highest current ID 8500-range shows Clinton/Franklin/Otsego/Lewis/Orange/Sullivan/Madison/Dutchess being booked for May-June 2026).

key_findings_summary: ONLY TWO AAR-hosted Greene County tax-foreclosure auctions exist: 3738 (Oct 12, 2022, 80 lots) and 6892 (Oct 29, 2025, 51 lots).
BOTH ARE CLOSED. Both remain fully accessible via /servlet/Search.do?auctionId=N with no auth.
Final sale prices and winning-bidder usernames are exposed per lot for closed auctions.
OWNER OF RECORD IS NOT IN THE AAR CATALOG -- must be joined from county assessment / RPS data via Tax Map # (SBL).
No 2021, 2023, 2024 Greene tax sale hosted by AAR. No 2026 Greene auction is yet on the schedule.
No machine-listing endpoint exists; ID-sweep is the only enumeration method.
Sister site nysauctions.com is a 301 alias of aarauctions.com (same data).

Field schema per lot (verified): Lot#, Address (with municipality), Property description, Tax Map# (SBL), Lot Size, School District, Full Market Value, Inspection, School/Village/County Tax Due, High Bid + Winner (after close).
Pagination param is page=N&perPage=20&orderBy= -- NOT pageNum.
Server forces gzip; use curl --compressed or python urllib + gzip.decompress.
